subject: Budget Playbook & Targets — QBR readiness and timeline
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Budget Playbook & Targets — QBR readiness and timeline

Team —

Kicking off a short planning thread to align leadership on targets and the QBR playbook we’ll present in January. Goal is to land a recommended set of top-line targets + two budget scenarios (base / upside) and a short ops impact note by Dec 10 so Finance and Sales Ops can start modeling.

High-level asks: 
- Marcus: pull model-level revenue and ARR impacts for Hosted API and Dedicated by end-of-day Dec 2.
- Laura: confirm stakeholder review slot on Dec 8 (30m) and whether we need an exec pre-brief.
- Stephanie: attach a first-pass playbook template (format for QBR, slides + one-pager) and any prior assumptions you used.

I attached a skeleton workbook (QBR_playbook_draft_v1.xlsx) and a short assumptions PDF — these are rough. Use the Google doc link below to comment.

Tentative timeline:
- Dec 2: internal numbers consolidated
- Dec 8: leadership review (30m)
- Dec 10: freeze recommended targets for Finance modeling

Please reply with any blockers or if you want a different cadence.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: QBR_playbook_draft_v1.xlsx (workbook stub), target_assumptions_2027.pdf (one-pager)
Links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1XbudgetPlaybookDraft
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Budget Playbook & Targets — QBR readiness and timeline

Rachel / team —

I’ll take the Hosted API and Dedicated demand curves. Quick clarifying Qs:
1) For the upside scenario, are we assuming a 20% increase in PLG conversion or is Sales expected to add incremental enterprise deals? I ask because the % impact to ARR is different.
2) Do we include a conservative headcount plan under opex (freeze hires) in the base case?

I’ll upload a numbers tab to the workbook by Dec 2 (named hosted_dedicated_model_v1). If Marcus S. from Finance needs the raw csv, I’ll drop it in the shared drive.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Strategy

Rachel / Marcus —

Dec 8 at 10:00 AM PT works for the 30m review. I recommend we do a quick 15m pre-brief with execs (me + Jonas) on Dec 7 to surface any escalations before the 8th. That will give us time to adjust asks for the CFO sync.

On top of the two scenarios, please prepare a short bullet list (one slide) on risks & mitigation:
- Capacity constraints (dedicated GPU pool utilization)
- Pricing sensitivity (impact on new ARR)
- Key hires and timing

I can coordinate the calendar invites. Marcus, if you can flag any model assumptions that materially change the target (e.g., >5% ARR delta), call that out in the numbers tab.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, GTM Strategy

- Pre-brief with execs: Dec 7, 3:00 PM PT (15m) — invite to follow
